findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "list_guide_parts" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: List all 12 parts (8 numbered parts + 4 appendices) of the Team Performance Science Guide, Performix's cited public reference on why team performance varies and…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
